title: Supershear rupture sustained through a thick fault zone in the 2025 Mw 7.8 Mandalay earthquake | Science
content: On 28 March 2025, a moment magnitude (Mw) 7.8 earthquake ruptured a seismic gap along the Sagaing fault in Myanmar, generating a surface rupture 480 km in length and causing widespread damage. With holistic geodetic and seismic techniques, we resolved ...
